[LGRA.9.5.1] Arithmetic productions:

```
additive       ::= multiplicative (('+' | '-') multiplicative)*
multiplicative ::= exponent (('*' | '/' | '//' | '%') exponent)*
exponent       ::= unary ('**' exponent)?                      # right-assoc (right-recursive)
unary          ::= ('-' | '+' | '~') unary
                |  postfix
```

`not` is the logical operator at the `not_expr` level (LGRA.9.3.1),
not the unary-arithmetic level. The `not_expr` production captures
that precedence position; `unary` here covers the arithmetic
unaries only.
